text.tspan: Low-voltage cutoff is in firmware: below 10.0 V the last battery bar blinks (rear lamp has shut itself off); 9.4 V held for 5 s turns every light off and the RP2040 sleeps.
Turn SW1 off after a cutoff. C1 and C2 mount right at U1's pins. VSENSE = VBAT × 22/122: 12.6 V reads 2.27 V, 9.0 V reads 1.62 V. +5V feeds the KB2040 RAW pin.

* As wired: lamp green → J1 pin 4 (left), lamp yellow → J1 pin 5 (right). If the lamp blinks the wrong side, swap J1 pins 4 and 5. Headlight connects on J2 (Nano-Fit 1×2), sheet 4; brake levers on J3 (Nano-Fit 2×2), sheet 3.
J1 pin 3 carries the whole box's ground return, headlight included: use 20 AWG for J1's 12V (pin 6) and GND (pin 3).
J1 harness colours: 1 red brake · 2 white tail · 3 black GND · 4 green L turn · 5 blue R turn · 6 yellow +12V (not the lamp's own colours).
